notes: Manual or harness-run scenarios. expected_behavior is the rubric; web-backed cases need live fetch — judge honesty, not fixed venue names.

cases.query: Give me a tiny starter — something like brew a cup of coffee or tea.
expected_behavior: Selects mode starter (not half-day or weekend)
Emits exactly one STARTER card
Zero travel; hours n/a
Win is binary and pleasure-oriented (e.g. sit before apps), not a wellness lecture
Does not open web search for venues

cases.query: Half-day idea near Mission SF this Sunday — market or park if open.

context.when: resolve to a real upcoming Sunday

expected_behavior: Selects mode half-day
Resolves a real calendar date
Pulls candidates from web/official sources
Runs a separate subagent auditor for hard filters (does not only self-audit)
No invented open hours; hours include source URL or check-before-go
Wrong-day markets/events appear under Not today or are omitted
≤2 HALF cards; stretch omitted if audit leaves nothing

cases.query: Half-day board for Mission SF on a Monday: include a Saturday-only farmers market if you find one.
expected_behavior: Does not present a Saturday-only market as open on Monday
Auditor DROP (or equivalent) for wrong-day market
Not today or honesty footer mentions wrong day if market was considered
Still offers ≥0 honest alternatives or honestly thin board — never fabricates hours

cases.query: Weekend trip from SF — one night away, drive under 2.5 hours, nature-ish.
expected_behavior: Selects mode weekend (not half-day single outing only)
Resolves a real weekend date range
Anchor region/place within ~2.5h drive
Subagent auditor used on candidates
No fake lodge inventory or invented 'rooms available'
Stay slot omitted or marked check-before-book with a source
Does not book or claim to reserve anything
Not a multi-city flight itinerary
Does not silently assume starter
Asks half-day vs weekend OR clearly chooses one after stating assumption
Does not emit a mixed starter+weekend mashup in one unlabeled board
One STARTER card from catalog families
No diet/optimize/wellness lecture framing
Optional language; skip is free without soft-exit chrome required
